notes: Statement of the private helper `coeff_linearForm_pow_eq_factorial_mul_prod` changed syntactically only: Mathlib removed `MvPolynomial.coeff m p` and replaced it with `p.coeff m` (`AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff`), which gives the same coefficient (the old `MvPolynomial.coeff m p` was `p m`; the new `p.coeff m` is the same Finsupp evaluation). So `coeff d (P)` became `(P).coeff d` with the same mathematical meaning. The lemma is private and only used in the same module's proof of `flagDegFormula`, whose statement is unchanged.
